title: Android Developer
tagline: Build apps for billions of Android devices with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose.
about: Android developers build apps for the world's most widely used mobile operating system. Modern Android development uses Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, with architecture components that make apps robust across thousands of device types.
Google's official Android Basics with Compose course is free and an excellent starting point; any computer can build Android apps.
day: Implement architecture with ViewModels and repositories
Handle networking, storage and background work
Test on many screen sizes and API levels

phases.title: Kotlin foundations
phases.goal: A modern, concise language with null safety.

nodes.d: Variables, types, null safety, control flow and functions.
Classes, data classes, interfaces and collection operations.
Projects, emulators, the debugger and Logcat.

phases.title: Compose apps
phases.goal: Build modern Android interfaces and app structure.

nodes.d: Declarative UI with composables, layouts and modifiers.
State hoisting and unidirectional data flow.
ViewModels, repositories and the recommended layered architecture.
Asynchronous work without blocking the UI.
Fetch data with Retrofit and store it with Room.
Google's design system for consistent, accessible Android UI.

project.d: A Compose app that syncs data from an API into Room, works offline, supports dark mode and adapts to tablets.

nodes.d: When Flutter or React Native make sense.
Signing, release tracks and store listings.

project.d: Ship an app to Google Play's internal or open testing track with tests in CI, crash reporting and a clear store listing.

interview: Architecture discussion: how would you structure this app?
Build a small list/detail screen live.
